description: Open the overflow menu. It has no id of ours — it is the framework's, and the only handle on it is what a screen reader would say.
The Model item in that menu, matched by its label because a menu item is not a view with our id on it.
Pick the service. A radio group rather than a spinner exactly so this line can exist.
The key. Substituted into a copy of this file on the runner; the committed version carries a placeholder.
Check the connection before anything is generated, so a wrong key is a sentence in the video rather than a generation that quietly does nothing.
Give the check time to reach the service and answer.
A picture of what the service said, whatever it said.
Save, which is the dialog's positive button and belongs to the framework.

description: Generate it. This is the tap that has never once happened with a credential behind it.
Generation is an HTTPS round trip and then some parsing. Long enough to finish, short enough to leave Robo time to explore afterwards.
